articles.title: NASA Photographs the Crater from a SpaceX Rocket's Lunar Crash
articles.summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage hit the Moon on August 5, creating a 60-foot-wide crater. NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter captured images after a six-day wait and precise timing. The impact site was found with international help, including South Korea's Danuri orbiter.

articles.title: Peek-a-Boo Damselfly Wins Top Prize in Ecology Photo Contest
articles.summary: An image of an orange-tailed marsh dart damselfly peering through a leaf hole won the 2026 BMC Ecology and Evolution image competition. The photo highlights the importance of threatened wetlands. Other winners showcase frog tracking, cuttlefish mating battles, and community-led sea turtle conservation.

articles.title: Black-Hole Stars: The Secret Behind the Universe's 'Little Red Dots'?
articles.summary: Astronomers have found the best evidence yet for a 'black-hole star'—a newborn supermassive black hole wrapped in a dense gas cocoon—inside a mysterious little red dot from 660 million years after the Big Bang. The object, MoM-BH*-1, shines 100 billion times brighter than any known star and has an unprecedented Balmer break, suggesting a new class of astrophysical object.
